description: Read back the agent's own per-message state — the record `claim_message` and `complete_message` write. Returns one row per message: its `messageId`, the `state` (pending, processing, done or failed), the labels and note the agent attached, who holds the claim and when. The rows belong to the CALLING credential, so another credential of the same tenant does not read them; `domainId` is required because the state is scoped to the domain whose mailbox received the message. Use it after a restart to find the messages this agent took and never finished: `state: "processing"` is that list.

domainId.description: The id of the domain whose mailbox received the messages — from `list_domains`. Required: the state belongs to one domain's mailbox.

state.description: Optional: only the states in this one. `processing` is the list a restarted agent wants — the messages it took and never finished.

name: list_message_states
